fusions.name: Fast Hold
fusions.desc: Reaches out an arm that deals 8 damage and has a 40% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Many Hands
fusions.desc: Pats down every enemy within 3 tiles for 4 damage.

fusions.name: Peeled Away
fusions.desc: Peels 2 conditions off you with spare arms.

fusions.name: Grip Past Reckoning
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 8%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
